description: This file is a PHP class 'FilterGroup' within the OpenCart admin controller for managing filter groups in the catalog. It includes methods for listing, editing, and saving filter groups, with typical CRUD operations and view rendering.

classes.name: FilterGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing filter groups in the admin catalog section, providing CRUD operations and view rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of filter groups with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of filter groups, primarily used as an API response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and renders the list of filter groups with filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a filter group.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of a filter group, whether adding new or editing existing.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected filter groups after permission check and returns JSON success or error message.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of filter group options matching a filter_name query, supporting autocomplete features.
